hooks.text: A four-million-sun black hole fits inside Mercury's orbit.
Can four million suns fit inside the orbit of Mercury?
Our galaxy's largest anchor is smaller than a planet's orbit.

title: Why Our Galaxy's Giant Black Hole Is Tiny
description: Sagittarius A-star holds the mass of four million suns yet fits inside a single planet's orbit. Scientists spent five years processing data to capture its first image.
